scenes.title: XGODY X4 or 886BT?
scenes.say: XGODY's best selling sat nav, the X4, or its most reviewed one, the 886BT? Here's the difference.

scenes.title: The big 9-inch screen
scenes.say: The X4 has a big nine inch screen, truck routing and lane assist. You need the X4 BT version, eighty nine ninety, for Bluetooth calling.

scenes.title: The proven pick
scenes.say: The 886BT is a seven inch truck navigator for seventy eight ninety, with Bluetooth included and over eleven hundred store reviews. The X4 has just nine.

scenes.title: Check the fine print
scenes.say: Heads up. XGODY's repair warranty is only a hundred and eighty days, its Trustpilot score is one point four, and map updates are files you copy yourself.

scenes.title:
Big screen → X4BT
Safer pick → 886BT
